traits.accuracy: How often the provider picks the right option on unambiguous typed questions (choice / score / noul).
traits.latency: Wall-clock per judge() call once the provider is warm.
traits.privacy: How little the judged state travels: local-only providers score highest, external APIs lowest. The hard floor is still the provider egress gate, not this trait.
traits.zero_config: Works with no operator opt-in, model download, resident worker or API key.

evidence: libs/core/reasoning/judgment-backend.ts (BUILTIN_JUDGMENT_PROVIDER: always present, local-only, never calibrated; the floor selectJudgmentBackend degrades to)
libs/core/organization/organization-operating-model-persistence.ts (registerOrganizationWorkJudgment: regex rule table, 5/6 on the JUDGMENT-SEAM-20260921 unambiguous set)

libs/core/provider/laya-mlx-judgment-backend.ts (egress 'local-only', deterministic open-weights encoder on MLX; 24 ms p50 warm, 6/6 with option descriptions; resident Python worker, opt-in via KYBERION_JUDGMENT_PROVIDERS)

libs/core/provider/typesafe-jev-judgment-backend.ts (egress 'external-api', hosted System One API; 235-278 ms over the network, 4/6 on the same set, non-deterministic; API key + opt-in via KYBERION_JUDGMENT_PROVIDERS)

accuracy.description: Typed questions where picking the right option matters more than latency or setup.

speed.description: Hot-path judgments where per-call latency matters most.

privacy.description: Prefer that the judged state never leaves the machine; the egress gate still enforces the tier floor.
